description: This file defines the Redis class within the Opencart System Library Session namespace. It implements session management using Redis by providing methods to read, write, destroy, and handle garbage collection of session data.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A class that manages session data storage in Redis, including reading, writing, destroying sessions, and garbage collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis session handler by establishing a connection to a Redis server and setting a session key prefix.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data associated with a given session ID from Redis and decodes it from JSON.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores session data in Redis under a key based on the session ID, encoding the data as JSON.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from Redis corresponding to a given session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection; redundant as Redis handles data expiration and cleanup.
